findings: Seven existing native face/text/geometry sources are previously consumed; none newly admitted as fresh holdout.
P8BK text/architecture observation was sheet-scale, only portrait explicitly full-resolution; no transcribed OCR ground truth, object-count or landmark annotation in inspected contract.
SA-LUT report covers 3 consumed sources and5nativecrop pairs; exact4096interpolation samples prove interpolation only.
Current Fable query/physical evidence explicitly lacks independent face/text and full-frame semantic coverage.
future_required_evidence: Before candidate evaluation: source provenance and historical overlap screen; scene-level train/development/test roles frozen.
Original-resolution annotations for readable text, object counts and edge/landmark locations in preregistered ROIs; no output-driven ROI selection.
Same input, same reference, all baseline/learned/physical arms; preserve outputs and failures at delivered precision.
Assess strong colour correctness separately from factual content preservation; no deterministic or nonnegative operator shortcut.
